content: PostgreSQL docs: round(numeric) breaks ties away from zero; round(double precision) tie-breaking is platform dependent, usually half-even. Row constructor < compares left to right and yields NULL if a compared pair has a NULL, so NULL sort keys must be COALESCEd (float8 -Infinity). Probe on PG 18.6 confirmed: round(82.5::numeric)=83, round(-2.5::numeric)=-3, round(2.5::float8)=2; GREATEST(0, NULL)=0.
